name: Shopwatch
description: Cycle-time measurement for the shop floor, organized by tool layout: one machine, one part, one operation, each with a number of its own. A layout holds the tools that cut it in order, with the pocket each sits in, the edges indexed there and the parts run between indexes. The stopwatch times one tool at a time and folds down to a bar while it runs; cutting time is measured at the machine rather than typed. Charts the layout's cycle across its tools and the cutting time against the waste, prints each tool layout as a one-page sheet, and reads and writes the whole record as CSV.
